question.problem:
Suppose we wish to find a critical point of the function $f(x,y)$ in the region $[-2,2]\times [0,2]⊆{R}^{2},$ where $$ f(x,y)=2{x}^{2}{y}^{2}+3{x}^{2}-xy-2x. $$ Calculate one iteration of the Newton-Raphson process for optimization that starts at ${x}_{0}=[-1,\,0]^{T}.$ Round your final answer to three decimal places (if needed).
${x}_{1}≈[$ $0.348$ $]$
{{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
The Newton-Raphson method of optimizing a multivariable function $f:{R}^{n}\to R$ is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-[{H}_{f}({x}_{n})]^{-1}∇f({x}_{n}),
$$

where $H({x}_{n})$ and $∇f({x}_{n})$ are the Hessian and gradient of $f$, respectively, evaluated at ${x}_{n}.$

In our case, the gradient is

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(2{x}^{2}{y}^{2}+3{x}^{2}-xy-2x) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(2{x}^{2}{y}^{2}+3{x}^{2}-xy-2x)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4x{y}^{2}+6x-y-2 \\ 4{x}^{2}y-x\end{aligned}],\end{aligned}
$$

and the Hessian is

$$
\begin{aligned}{H}_{f}(x) & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂}{∂x}(4x{y}^{2}+6x-y-2) & \frac{∂}{∂x}(4{x}^{2}y-x) \\ \frac{∂}{∂y}(4x{y}^{2}+6x-y-2) & \frac{∂}{∂y}(4{x}^{2}y-x)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4{y}^{2}+6 & 8xy-1 \\ 8xy-1 & 4{x}^{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our Newton-Raphson formula is

$$
{x}_{n+1}={x}_{n}-{[\begin{aligned}4{y}^{2}+6 & 8xy-1 \\ 8xy-1 & 4{x}^{2}\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}4x{y}^{2}+6x-y-2 \\ 4{x}^{2}y-x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{n}}.
$$

Starting with
${x}_{0}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & ={x}_{0}-{[\begin{aligned}4{y}^{2}+6 & 8xy-1 \\ 8xy-1 & 4{x}^{2}\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}}^{-1}{[\begin{aligned}4x{y}^{2}+6x-y-2 \\ 4{x}^{2}y-x\end{aligned}]}_{{x}_{0}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}4(0)^{2}+6 & 8(-1)(0)-1 \\ 8(-1)(0)-1 & 4(-1)^{2}\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}4(-1)(0)^{2}+6(-1)-0-2 \\ 4(-1)^{2}(0)-(-1)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-{[\begin{aligned}6 & -1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{6\cdot 4-(-1)\cdot (-1)}[\begin{aligned}4 & 1 \\ 1 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]-\frac{1}{23}[\begin{aligned}-31 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & ≈[\begin{aligned}0.348 \\ 0.087\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
